title: A file that shadows clean
objective: Declare clean phony so that the stray file called clean does not make make skip the recipe.
hint: make compares the target name with the filesystem. .PHONY: clean tells make that clean is a name to run, never a file to check.

steps.description: build the file that clean is supposed to remove
the dry run shows the recipe and removes nothing
clean really runs, even though a file named clean exists

lesson.prediction: When there is already a file called clean in the directory, will make clean delete the product?
hints: By default, make treats the target name as a possible existing file.
.PHONY: clean tells make clean to never be a file.
You can put the .PHONY statement before or after the clean rule.
lesson.explanation: The .PHONY target does not participate in file timestamp determination and will be executed every time it is requested.
